claims: Morgan Wallen competed on Season 6 of The Voice in 2014.
Morgan Wallen made it to the Playoffs on The Voice.
Morgan Wallen was eliminated in the Playoffs round on The Voice.
Morgan Wallen was eliminated before the live shows on The Voice.
Morgan Wallen was originally on Team Usher on The Voice.
Morgan Wallen was stolen by Team Adam Levine on The Voice.
Morgan Wallen was a 20-year-old Tennessee native during Season 6 of The Voice.
Morgan Wallen sang "Collide" by Howie Day during his audition on The Voice.
Morgan Wallen chose Usher as his coach on The Voice.
Morgan Wallen later noted that his elimination came after he finally sang a country song.
Sergio Sanchez of Atom Smash worked with Morgan Wallen immediately after his exit from The Voice.
Morgan Wallen did not win The Voice.
Morgan Wallen has credited The Voice with kick-starting his career.
Morgan Wallen has credited The Voice with helping him find his artistic identity.
